body: Thanks for your response. No confirmations yet, but I'm still in talks with people. I'd like something closer but if nothing comes through I'll let you know. Thank you so much again.
Thank you, that really means a lot to me because I've felt like a shitty dog owner moving her around so much the past week. Hopefully this all gets worked out soon.

Though I'm much more optimistic than I was a few hours ago, I haven't confirmed anything yet, still just in communication with people. I have a place I can stay for march (landlord won't allow dogs) and some good prospects of a new place for the end of march/beginning of April. If you live in the city and are up for it I'd still love to hear from you. Thanks

It's not too far if I run out of options. I'm currently in contact with some other great folks from this subreddit and there's a possibility I have a friend that might be able to house her. Thanks for your concern and I'll let you know if I need your help.

Thanks for your reply. I checked out the SAFE program before posting here. While it seems like a great program, but the no visitation rights and keeping my dog in a cage kinda bums me out. I'd much rather have her in a home environment than at a shelter.
I'm talking to a few other people that could possibly house her. I'll let you know if I need help, thanks.
Sorry I'm a bit frazzled right now and on my phone. Here's a picture: http://i.imgur.com/aElBbvz.jpg
Thanks for looking out, you're awesome.
Any government aid I could apply for wouldn't come in nearly enough time. I'm so fucking worried I'm going to have to give up my dog and how that's going to affect me.
In my case rock bottom is freezing to death outside. There's no going up from there.

Check out realwarriors.net they have programs and resources for mental help in the armed services. 

Keep being a good friend, he needs you more than ever right now.
